name: Hawaii
source: Hawaii Department of Taxation Announcement 2024-03 on Act 46, SLH 2024 (https://files.hawaii.gov/tax/news/announce/ann24-03.pdf, read again 2026-10-24): 2025 brackets kept for 2026 (every threshold, rate and base of the single and joint tables match), standard deduction 8,000 / 16,000 for 2026; personal exemption 1,144 and the extra exemption at 65 from the 2025 Form N-11 instructions (https://files.hawaii.gov/tax/forms/2025/n11ins.pdf, read 2026-10-24) and Booklet A for 2026 withholding (https://files.hawaii.gov/tax/news/pubs/25BkltA.pdf, allowance 1,144). Tax Foundation, State Individual Income Tax Rates and Brackets 2026 (https://taxfoundation.org/data/all/state/state-income-tax-rates-2026/) agrees on the brackets. The 2026 Form N-11 is not yet published. Act 24, SLH 2026 (13% above 1,000,000) starts in 2027 and is not modelled

filing_tables.note: Single and married filing separately share one rate schedule, joint and surviving spouse the other (Hawaii Department of Taxation Announcement 2024-03, read 2026-10-24). Head of household is not modelled.

state_base.note: Hawaii starts from federal adjusted gross income and follows the federal treatment of 401(k) and 403(b) deferrals, Traditional IRA deposits and HSA deposits: the Hawaii Additions Worksheet of the 2025 Form N-11 instructions (read 2026-10-24) has no line for them (also https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2026/bills/HB2329_SD1_.HTM, validation run 3, 2026-10-22). Not modelled: Hawaii excludes employer-funded pension income; distributions from employee-elective plans (401(k), IRAs) are taxable, so the model's Traditional withdrawals are taxed in full and no retirement_exclusion section is needed.

income_brackets.note: Every threshold and rate of the single and joint tables matches the 2025 schedules, which Act 46 (SLH 2024) keeps for 2026 (Announcement 2024-03, read 2026-10-24); the bases are the exact cumulative tax (the announcement rounds them). The wider brackets from 2027 and the Act 24 13% bracket are not modelled.

standard_deduction.note: Hawaii Department of Taxation Announcement 2024-03 (read 2026-10-24): Act 46 amounts for 2026 and 2027, set by statute, not indexed (9,000 / 18,000 from 2028; not modelled). The 2025 Form N-11 instructions give 4,400 / 8,800 for 2025, as the announcement says. The bracket bases are exact cumulative tax; the announcement rounds them to whole dollars (134 for 134.40). Not modelled: the 7.25% cap on net capital gains, the wider brackets from 2027 (Act 46) and the 13% bracket from 2027 (Act 24, 2026).

exemptions.note: Personal exemption of 1,144 per person and dependent, and an additional 1,144 for each person 65 or older: 2025 Form N-11 instructions (read 2026-10-24: 1,144 for each exemption claimed; the filing thresholds for 65 or older, such as 6,688 single, are the standard deduction plus two exemptions). A fixed statutory amount, not indexed; Booklet A for 2026 withholding still uses 1,144.

estate_inheritance.check_at: HRS 236E-6 and 236E-8; https://tax.hawaii.gov (estate and transfer tax)
estate_inheritance.note: Hawaii estate tax: exemption 5,490,000, then 10% on the first 1,000,000 above it, 11%, 12%, 13%, 14% for each further million, 15.7% from 5,000,000 to 10,000,000 and 20% above (Valur table; AARP 2026 gives 5.49 million and 10% to 20%; SimplyTrust 5.5 million citing HRS 236E). No inheritance tax.

social_security.note: Hawaii does not tax Social Security or first-tier Railroad Retirement benefits: 2025 Form N-11 instructions, line 14 (read 2026-10-24); also Booklet A (https://files.hawaii.gov/tax/news/pubs/25BkltA.pdf, validation run 2, 2026-10-22).

local_income_tax.check_at: Hawaii county tax pages (no county income tax is authorised)
local_income_tax.note: Hawaii counties levy no income tax: Hawaii is not among the 16 states with local income taxes in Tax Foundation, Local Income Taxes (https://taxfoundation.org/research/all/state/local-income-taxes-2023/, updated 2024-06-13, read 2026-10-24), and the 2025 Form N-11 has no county tax line (state-costs.csv local_income_tax none).

sales_tax.check_at: Hawaii revenue department sales and use tax rate tables
sales_tax.source: Tax Foundation, State and Local Sales Tax Rates, Midyear 2026 (https://taxfoundation.org/data/all/state/2026-sales-tax-rates-midyear/), as of 2026-07-01; groceries and clothing: https://zamp.com/resources/sales-tax-on-groceries and https://zamp.com/blog/sales-tax-on-clothing
sales_tax.note: Rates as fractions; avg_local_rate is the combined less the state rate, at least 0. vehicle_rate is the purchase tax on a car: assumed equal to the combined rate. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py. Groceries and clothing: grocery_rate is the state rate on groceries (0.04) plus the average local rate where locals tax them (locals: yes); research note: GET 4% full rate on food plus 0.5% county surcharge; refundable food/excise tax credit for lower incomes. clothing_taxable is true (research: yes; taxed). Set by hand from .claude/state/research/grocery-tax.csv and clothing-tax.csv (s329).

property_tax.check_at: Census ACS 2024 1-year tables B25090 and B25082 at https://data.census.gov
property_tax.source: Census ACS 2024 1-year (B25090 / B25082) as compiled at https://floridaprobateandfamilylaw.com/blog/effective-property-tax-rates-by-state-2025/
property_tax.note: Effective rate: real-estate taxes paid divided by home value, owner-occupied homes. Senior relief, homestead caps and freezes are not in it (a buyer pays the full rate). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

home_insurance.source: Insurify state table for a 300,000 dwelling (https://insurify.com/homeowners-insurance/states/), October 2026
home_insurance.note: Average annual premium for a 300,000 dwelling. Quote averages differ by 20 to 40 percent between publishers, so the model uses it as a ratio between states only. Research note: home_ins excludes separate hurricane cover. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

car_insurance.source: Insurify full coverage, monthly times 12 (https://insurify.com/car-insurance/states/), October 2026
car_insurance.note: Average annual full-coverage premium. Used as a ratio between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

car_taxes.check_at: City and County of Honolulu motor vehicle registration page (https://www.honolulu.gov/csd/motor-vehicle-registration/) and county fee pages
car_taxes.source: Honolulu Department of Customer Services example: 367 a year (incl. 10 beautification and 0.50 emblem) for a 3,320 lb car (state fee 46, state weight tax 58.10, county weight tax 232.40, county fee 20, beautification and emblem fees)
car_taxes.note: Hawaii: about 367 a year on Oahu (Honolulu example, https://www.honolulu.gov/csd/motor-vehicle-registration/, validation run 2, 2026-10-22) (about 70% of residents) and less on the neighbor islands, whose weight taxes are lower; about 340 averaged (estimate). Honolulu Bill 47 would cut the county weight tax from July 2027 (not modelled). Typical car, averaged over about ten years of ownership; registration and vehicle taxes only (no title, plate or inspection fees). Set by hand after the import: rerunning importStateCosts.py resets it to 0. Accepted: low impact (triage 2026-10-23): County weight rates support the blend.

fuel.check_at: Hawaii motor fuel tax page and EIA gasoline prices (https://www.eia.gov/petroleum/gasdiesel/)
fuel.source: Excise: USGasGauge/EIA (https://usgasgauge.com/gas-tax) and Kiplinger 2026 for some states, memory for the rest; price: USGasGauge state-by-year table (AAA data), 2024 annual average
fuel.note: gas_tax_per_gallon is the state excise in dollars, without sales tax on fuel; average_price_per_gallon is the 2024 average pump price (grade unclear, about regular). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

utilities.source: EIA Electric Power Monthly Table 5.6.B, residential price, January to July 2026
utilities.note: Average residential electricity price in dollars per kWh, January to July 2026 (a partial year). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

housing.check_at: https://fred.stlouisfed.org (Zillow Home Value Index by state) and https://meric.mo.gov/data/cost-living-data-series
housing.source: Zillow Home Value Index by state via FRED (September 2026); MERIC Cost of Living Data Series housing index (C2ER, US = 100), Q2 2026
housing.note: typical_home_value is the Zillow Home Value Index (all homes, middle tier); cost_index is the MERIC housing cost index (US = 100), used to scale rent after a move. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

health_premiums.check_at: https://www.kff.org/affordable-care-act/state-indicator/average-marketplace-premiums-by-metal-tier/, Hawaii insurance department Medigap rate guide and the CMS MA Landscape and Part D files (https://www.cms.gov)
health_premiums.source: KFF Average Marketplace Premiums by Metal Tier 2026 (benchmark silver at 40, times the federal age curve 2.124 for 60); MoneyGeek Medicare Supplement Plan G at 65, 2026; KFF Average Monthly Premium for PDPs, 2024; MedicareSupplement.com analysis of the CMS 2026 MA Landscape files
health_premiums.note: Monthly premiums per person, unsubsidized list prices: aca_60_monthly is the benchmark silver plan at 60 (estimated from the age-40 figure), medigap_g_monthly Plan G at 65, part_d_monthly the enrollment-weighted Part D plan, medicare_advantage_monthly the average Medicare Advantage premium. Null means no usable figure; a move then leaves that premium unchanged. Used as ratios between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

price_indexes.source: MERIC Cost of Living Data Series grocery index (C2ER, US = 100), Q2 2026; BEA Regional Price Parities by state, goods and other services (US = 100), 2024, release of 2026-02-19 via FRED
price_indexes.note: Price levels with US = 100: grocery_index is the MERIC grocery index, bea_goods and bea_services the BEA Regional Price Parities for goods and for services other than rent. Used as ratios between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

long_term_care.source: Genworth / CareScout Cost of Care Survey 2024, Ranked State Data Tables, state medians (https://assets.carescout.com/a41bb6478c/298701.pdf)
long_term_care.note: State median monthly costs: a home health aide, an assisted living facility and a private nursing home room. Stored for reference; the model does not use them. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.
